QUOTATION
Our Ref: NW/26/0101
Date: 14/08/2026
To: Gulf Horizon Contracting Co. W.L.L.
Attn: Mr. Faisal Al-Rashid, Estimation Engineer
Project: Al Noor Tower, Kuwait City

Subject: Supply and installation of roof-mounted building maintenance unit (BMU)

Dear Sir,

Thank you for your enquiry. We are pleased to offer the supply and installation of one roof-mounted building maintenance unit (BMU) with a NorthStar twin-hoist cradle for the Al Noor Tower.
The cradle and the BMU are designed to BS EN 1808:2015 and installed in accordance with BS 6037-1:2017.
All lifting equipment is handed over with a thorough examination report under LOLER 1998.

Price: GBP 245,000.00
Payment: 30% advance, 60% on delivery, 10% on commissioning
Validity: 30 days from the date of this quotation
Delivery: 16 weeks from approved drawings
Warranty: 12 months from handover
Exclusions: Civil works, power supply to the roof, scaffolding by others.
